samir: Auditor asked for evidence showing that an ECS task role never had KMS decrypt on the CMK used for customer data. We rotated the key last week but need a clean chain showing role bindings + CloudTrail events. Anyone on this?

elaine: I can pull the role bindings and the PR that removed the old inline policy. PR is #3821. I also have the KMS rotation log entry. Will package.

kevin: FYI Splunk has the CloudTrail export for the window. Query I used:
```
index=aws sourcetype="aws:cloudtrail" eventName=Decrypt resource.type="kms" OR requestParameters.keyId="arn:aws:kms:us-east-1:111222333:key/abcd-ef01" | table _time, userIdentity.principalId, eventName, requestParameters
```
Returns nothing for the ECS task role principal after 2026-03-10.

samir: perfect — auditor wants a signed chain: 1) RBAC change PR, 2) CloudTrail search result screenshot and raw events, 3) KMS key policy history, 4) key rotation record, and 5) a short statement that no other service account had access.

ashley: I can generate the export bundle. Steps I'll follow: collect PR link + commit sha, export CloudTrail JSON (timeboxed), screenshot of Splunk query, KMS rotation history via AWS CLI, and an ops statement.

kevin: For KMS rotation history you can run:
```
aws kms get-key-rotation-status --key-id abcd-ef01
aws kms list-keys --region us-east-1
aws kms get-key-policy --key-id abcd-ef01 --policy-name default
```
Also `aws kms list-grants --key-id abcd-ef01` for current grants.

deploy-bot: deploy log: samir/infra PR #3821 merged by elaine at 2026-03-11T15:02:14Z :white_check_mark:

auditor_johnson: For the auditor report we need timestamps and export filenames. Can you include SHA256 hashes of the exported JSON blobs and a short note on who verified the bundle? Also need the last time the CMK was used to decrypt customer data.

elaine: I added the verification step to the packaging playbook. I'll produce sha256 for each artifact and a verification.txt signed by me (PGP key id 0xAB12CDEF). I can confirm last decrypt event for that key was 2026-03-09T22:11:03Z (CloudTrail event id: 1234-5678-evt).

samir: thanks. Ashley, can you also include the timeline of the vuln triage? The auditor is asking why the RBAC change was prioritized and what mitigation was in place between detection and remediation. A short incident timeline will suffice.

ashley: will do. Timeline draft: 2026-03-08 detection (vuln scanner flagged overly permissive inline policy), 2026-03-09 triage (confirmed scope), 2026-03-10 PR opened to remove decrypt permission on task role, 2026-03-11 PR merged and key rotation scheduled, 2026-03-11 rotation completed. I'll attach the vuln tracker ID: VT-2026-014.

kevin: sample Splunk screenshot note included and I exported raw events to `cloudtrail-decrypt-events-2248005432.json`. SHA256: `e3b0c44298fc1c149afbf4c8996fb924...` (placeholder until I run the hash).

samir: auditor also requested proof that no automated job re-granted the permission. We should include a grep over IaC commits for that timeframe.

elaine: I already ran `git log --since=2026-03-01 --until=2026-03-12 -S"kms:Decrypt" -- terraform/` and got only the inline policy removal commit. I'll include the git diff and commit sha in the bundle.

auditor_johnson: This looks good so far. Final ask: include the process owner who approved remediation, and a signed confirmation that there is no outstanding remediation task. Once we have the bundle and hashes I can mark the control as evidence-complete.

samir: owner is @elaine, remediation approved by @kevin. Ashley to attach the signed confirmation.txt.

ashley: packing artifacts now. ETA 30m, will post S3 link and checksums when ready. :hourglass_flowing_sand:

deploy-bot: artifact upload success: s3://redwood-compliance/audit-bundles/2248005432-ecs-kms-audit.tar.gz (acl:private)

kevin: checksum posted to thread in the artifact manifest file.

auditor_johnson: Received. I'll validate signatures and mark completed or follow up with any gaps. Thanks team. :thumbsup:
